query: Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new dog park downtown, and he had so much fun chasing after a little border collie that he ended up covered in mud and we had to give him a full bath as soon as we got home. I also tried that new matcha bakery everyone’s been posting about yesterday, their red bean mochi is so chewy and not too sweet, I already bought a box to bring to my colleague’s birthday potluck next week. My tomato plants on the balcony are finally starting to grow little green fruits too, I’ve been watering them every morning before work and I’m so excited to pick the first ripe one soon. Anyway, I need to exchange an item from my delivered order #W1671835: I want to change item 5081446110 to item 3399869890, and use paypal_6918118 as the payment method for any additional fees related to this exchange.
